jobs.title: Office Manager / Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------


Stic is modernizing out\-of\-home, one of advertising's oldest formats. Billboards and transit ads have always sold impressions on faith. Stic replaces faith by turning everyday vehicles into GPS\-tracked, mobile media. Brands get proof instead of best guesses. Drivers earn passive income on miles they're already driving.


Stic Vision is how it works. An edge AI device small enough to live inside a decal, streaming informative analytics with no vehicle\-level integration required.


The global out\-of\-home advertising market is worth roughly $40 billion a year. Stic is building the measurement layer that legacy OOH never had.


Stic is trusted by brands like TikTok, Dunkin Donuts, e.l.f., and PacSun. The traction is already showing up in results: a SXSW campaign for TikTok Radio put 44 vehicles on the road in Austin and generated 3\.9 million tracked impressions. That's real, revenue\-generating proof in a category still mostly sold on assumptions.


Stic is lean by design. People joining now build the playbook rather than inheriting one. This means fast execution and explosive career growth, without the layers of process that slows things down at bigger companies.

**About You**


You make administration disappear. The executive you support stops thinking about their inbox. The office runs without reminders, and campaigns never stall over logistics. Nobody on the team books their own travel.


You see what needs doing before anyone asks, then own it end to end. You take real pride in order and follow\-through. Loose ends bother you, so you close them. If you like being the quiet operating system behind a busy team, you'll like it here.

 **What You Will Own**

* **Your executive's time \-** you'll take over their inbox and calendar so they only see what needs their judgment. Everything else gets handled, routed, or filed before it reaches them. Nothing waiting on their approval sits for more than a business day.
* **The office \-** kitchen supplies, deliveries, food and meals, vendor coordination, and building management all run without anyone having to think about it. The space stays tidy and stocked as a matter of course, not as a fire drill.
* **Operations and logistics \-** you'll build and run the systems that keep physical campaign materials (stickers, decals, and similar) moving. Organizing them by campaign, mapping the pickup and delivery cycle including manufacturer lead times, and keeping everything on a predictable schedule. The goal: no campaign or install is ever delayed by a supply or logistics gap.
* **Travel \-** you'll own executive and sales travel end to end, so account executives stop booking their own. Requests go from ask to confirmed itinerary within a business day, and trips don't get disrupted by booking errors.
* **Make it repeatable \-** you'll document the recurring work clearly enough that someone else could pick it up cold. You’ll keep documentation current so the office never depends on you being in the room.




**What Success Looks Like**

We believe in being specific about what "good" means, so you know exactly what you're walking into:

* **By 30 days**: you're fluent in our tools (including Jira), actively managing the inbox and calendar, and the office essentials (supplies, deliveries, food, vendors, building management) run without escalation.
* **By 60–90 days**: the executive reads only what needs their decision; logistics for pickups and deliveries run on a schedule without prompting; and you own all executive and sales travel.
* **By 6 months**: the recurring work is documented well enough that another person could cover the inbox, calendar, and office logistics for a full week using your notes alone.
* **Across the year**: zero campaigns delayed by logistics, zero trips derailed by a booking error, and documentation that stays current quarter over quarter.

**What You’ll Need to Have**

* Experience as an executive assistant, office manager, or operations coordinator \- ideally some blend of all three.
* Proactive to a fault. You spot the gap and close it before it's raised.
* A track record of booking and managing complex travel.
* Deeply organized, with the follow\-through to match. Loose ends genuinely bother you.
* Comfortable owning logistics and vendor relationships, and coordinating moving parts across people and timelines.
* A clear, concise writer, a big part of this role is communicating on the executive's behalf.
* Quick to learn new tools and systems (we use Jira; you don't need to know it on day one, but you should be able to get proficient fast).
* Discreet and trustworthy with sensitive information and a busy leader's time.
* Happy working in\-office and being the hub the team relies on.
* Ideally, experience in a startup or other fast\-moving environment, familiarity with Jira or similar project\-tracking tools, a background in physical logistics, inventory, or supply coordination.

**Base Salary:** $35 \- $41 an hour, plus benefits


**Work Location:** Los Angeles \- in person

**Benefits**

* Join a well\-funded early\-stage company disrupting traditional advertising with patent pending technology
* Explosive career growth
* Health \& dental insurance
* 26 days off per year (15 PTO / 11 holidays) prorated for any partial year of employment
* 401(k)

By tackling the complexities of enrollment, administration, renewal, billing, and more, we enable our customers and partners to concentrate on advancing their core missions.

We value each employee's unique talents and contributions and understand that every individual plays a critical role in our mission to transform healthcare. Every day, we celebrate our team's dedication, creativity, and expertise, which drive us closer to our goals.


At Softheon, our mission is making healthcare more affordable, accessible, and plentiful for every American. Our vision is that everyone can access and choose the healthcare they need.

  


About the Role
We are looking for a Project Coordinator to join our Project Management team and support the successful delivery of client\-facing and internal implementation projects. In this role, you will work closely with Project Managers, Lead Project Managers, cross\-functional teams, clients, and external stakeholders to help coordinate project activities, maintain project documentation, track action items, support meeting preparation, and ensure project information stays organized and up to date.


A successful Project Coordinator at Softheon is highly organized, detail\-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys keeping teams aligned, following up on open items, maintaining accurate documentation, and helping project teams stay on track from initiation through closing.


Success in this role means project artifacts are accurate, meetings are well\-prepared, action items are clearly tracked, follow\-ups are timely, and Project Managers have the coordination support needed to focus on delivery oversight, client engagement, risk management, and strategic project execution.

 **Requirements**  

  

You Will:**Project Coordination and Administrative Support**

* Support Project Managers with day\-to\-day project coordination activities across new client implementations and internal projects.
* Maintain project plans, trackers, meeting notes, action item logs, decision logs, risk/issue logs, and other project documentation.
* Help ensure project activities, deliverables, owners, and due dates are clearly documented and followed up on.
* Track project milestones and assist in identifying items that may require PM follow\-up or escalation.
* Support accurate and timely updates in project management tools, including Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, SharePoint, and other PMO systems.

**Meeting Coordination and Follow\-Up**

* Schedule, organize, and support project meetings, including internal team meetings, client\-facing meetings, implementation check\-ins, and status review sessions.
* Prepare meeting agendas, capture meeting notes, document decisions, and distribute follow\-up items.
* Track action items from meetings and follow up with responsible owners to help ensure timely completion.
* Assist Project Managers in preparing materials for project status meetings, executive updates, and stakeholder communications.

**Project Monitoring and Reporting Support**

* Assist with monitoring day\-to\-day project activities and ensuring work is progressing according to plan.
* Support the preparation of project status reports, dashboards, and other stakeholder\-facing updates.
* Help gather updates from cross\-functional teams and consolidate information for PM review.
* Identify missing, outdated, or unclear project information and bring it to the attention of the assigned Project Manager.

**Stakeholder and Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with cross\-departmental teams, including Product, Operations, IT, Infrastructure, and other business teams, to support coordination of project tasks and timelines.
* Assist with communicating deadlines, dependencies, and follow\-up needs to internal stakeholders.
* Support Project Managers in creating clear visibility into project status, blockers, risks, and outstanding decisions.
* Help ensure internal teams remain aligned on project requirements, deadlines, schedules, and next steps.

**Documentation and Process Support**

* Coordinate the creation and maintenance of project documentation, SOPs, implementation materials, training documentation, and project handoff materials.
* Support PMO best practices by helping ensure project documentation, trackers, naming conventions, and templates are used consistently.
* Assist with organizing project files and ensuring key materials are accessible, accurate, and up to date.
* Participate in post\-project lessons learned by helping gather feedback, organize findings, and document improvement opportunities.

jobs.description:
**Account Manager / Technical Recruiter (Entry Level)**

Remote \| 0 to 2 Years Experience \| First\-Year Target: $50K to $120K

MBS Innovations is a recruiting agency focused on AI and engineering talent. We opened under nine months ago and are already past seven figures in revenue, and we're hiring to keep up. Our founder spent 18 years helping build one of the largest tech staffing agencies in America before starting his own, and he's in the trenches with the team every day rather than managing from a distance. We plan to add 20\+ people before the end of the year.

**Our clients**

We recruit for AI labs, the infrastructure companies much of the industry runs on, and applied AI startups growing quickly. Most are backed by well\-known venture and strategic investors. We also work with Fortune 1000 companies standing up serious AI and engineering teams for the first time.

The work these companies are doing is not incremental. Some are building the models and compute everything else gets built on. Some are working on drug discovery and cutting years off the time it takes to get a treatment to a patient. Some are launching hardware into orbit. Some are rebuilding the power grid, or the tools that let a single engineer do what used to take a team of fifty.

The common thread is that the engineers they need are rare. There are not many people who can do this work, and finding them is the job.

**How we work**

Our process is AI centric, built that way from day one rather than layered onto an old playbook. Sourcing, screening, matching, outreach, scheduling, and pipeline tracking all run on automation, using both the best tools on the market and several we've built ourselves. We expect you to be genuinely interested in that side of the work.

What technology can't do is the rest of it. Once a candidate is in process, they get a real person who picks up the phone, tells them the truth, and checks in daily. Candidates notice, and it's why they come back to us and refer their friends.

**What you'll do**

You will own the process end to end: finding software and AI engineers, talking with them, understanding what they actually want, matching them to open roles across our client base, and staying with them through interviews, offers, and close. Some days it feels like sales and some days it feels like career counseling. Usually both.

* Source and reach out to engineers across AI, ML, infrastructure, and full\-stack
* Screen and interview candidates
* Run multiple candidate processes at the same time
* Coordinate interview loops, prep candidates beforehand, and pass feedback both directions
* Negotiate and close offers
* Build a network you will draw on for the rest of your career

**What we're looking for**

We care more about how you operate than where you have worked. Recruiting experience helps, but many of our best people came in with none.

* Moves quickly, because in this business getting there first usually decides it
* Takes in a great deal of information at once and makes decisions without all of it
* Genuinely curious about technology and what these companies are building
* Competitive
* Takes coaching well, because you will be getting a lot of it
* Extremely organized
* Strong on the phone and in writing

**Requirements**

* 4 year college degree

**Compensation and benefits**

* $50,000 to $120,000 first year, based on production
* Health coverage
* Fully remote
* Unlimited PTO, and we mean it, take it
* Direct mentoring from leadership, daily
* Access to tools most recruiters never touch
* Real room to move up as we grow

We are adding people faster than we can promote them, so there is open space above you right now.

**Send a resume, or write us a few lines about why you are interested.**

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote
